questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Introduction to Structural Steel & Limit State Design Concepts
questions.text: Explain Properties of Structural Steel and Limit State Design of Steel Structures (IS 800:2007). Explain Bolted Connections (Bearing type vs HSFG Friction Grip bolts) and Welded Connections (Fillet weld vs Butt weld). Calculate strength and efficiency of a lap/butt joint.

Design a Tension Member (Single/Double Angle section) connected to a gusset plate to carry a factored tensile load $T_u = 250 \text{ kN}$. Check for yielding of gross section ($T_{dg}$), rupture of critical section ($T_{dn}$ with shear lag factor $\beta$), and block shear failure ($T_{db}$).

questions.chapter: Chapter 3: Design of Tension Members & Lug Angles
questions.text: Design a Built-up Compression Member (Two ISMC channels face-to-face or back-to-back) with Lacing System or Batten System to carry an axial factored load $P_u = 1200 \text{ kN}$ of length $L = 5 \text{ m}$. Check slenderness ratio $\lambda \le 180$ and design lacing flats and welds.

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Design of Compression Members & Built-Up Columns
questions.text: Design a Laterally Supported / Unsupported Steel Beam (ISMB section) of effective span $6 \text{ m}$ carrying a factored UDL $w_u = 40 \text{ kN/m}$. Check for: (a) Bending strength, (b) Shear strength ($V_u \le 0.6 V_d$), (c) Web buckling and web crippling, and (d) Deflection limits.

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Design of Column Bases & Roof Trusses
questions.text: Design a Slab Base and Gusseted Base for a column carrying an axial factored load. Design the concrete pedestal, anchor bolts, and weld connections.
